accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.intro: The Municipality of Broumy is committed to making its website accessible in accordance with Act No. 99/2019 Coll. on the accessibility of websites and mobile applications, which transposes Directive (EU) 2016/2102 of the European Parliament and of the Council into Czech law.
accessibility.statusBody: This portal complies with Act No. 99/2019 Coll. and meets WCAG 2.1 level AA accessibility rules.
accessibility.processedBody: This statement was prepared on 1 August 2026. It was assessed using self-evaluation.
accessibility.feedbackBody: If you encounter any accessibility problem with this portal, please contact the designated person below.
accessibility.enforcementBody: If the response to a notice or request submitted under Directive (EU) 2016/2102 is unsatisfactory, contact the Ministry of the Interior of the Czech Republic, eGovernment Department.
